notes: Network to county sites and the SOS opened about 14:07 UTC; Comal evidence was gathered after that through the fetch module. The county Past Election Results page (comalcounty.gov/973) links 2026 elections to Enhanced Voting (app.enhancedvoting.com/results/public/comal-county-tx/elections/ComalCountyPrimary for Mar 3 2026, .../ComalCountyPrimaryRunoff26 for May 26 2026) and 2024 and earlier elections to Clarity ENR (results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Comal/122856/web.345435/#/summary for Nov 5 2024). So the platform changed from clarity_style (through May 2025) to a vendor-hosted Enhanced Voting site in 2026; platform/host record the current 2026 platform. The Elections and Voter Registration page Quick Links still has 'Election Results' pointing to results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Comal/. Both vendor pages are JavaScript single-page apps; the Enhanced Voting page HTML has no result data or notice text, and Clarity current_ver.txt for election 122856 returned '355369' (a version number only), so neither shows when precinct-level results first appeared on election night. A search summary said the Enhanced Voting site provided 'Real-time results' for the Mar 3 2026 primary (lead only, attributed loosely to herald-zeitung.com; it says nothing about precinct-level timing). The platform switch is observed from links, not a stated change about precinct-level reporting, so stated_change_2026 is n. Contact: phone '830-221-1352' and 'Email Elections & Voter Registration' (Cloudflare-obfuscated, decoded to elections@co.comal.tx.us) are on the county Elections & Voter Registration page; the TX SOS list gives Comal County Clerk Bobbie Koepp, (830) 221-1352, County Email Address mailto cjaqua@comalcounty.gov (elections coordinator). Wayback probes for both vendor prefixes failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). No WebFetch attempted. Usage notice: none visible in fetched HTML (SPA), left empty.
tag_rationale: Results are on vendor-hosted sites (Clarity for 2024, Enhanced Voting for 2026), but no source shows when precinct-level results were posted on election night.
